case.title: Design- No technicians yet and Nothing here yet in both views
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Location {Location-B} has work orders but no technicians.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST Location No Techs.
  • Location {Location-C} has no technicians and no work orders.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST Location Empty.
  • You can change location to {Location-B} and {Location-C}.
  • User {User-B} can open Work Orders at {Location-B}, and their role does not have the permission "Settings → App".
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682436 Viewer, with a custom role that has only Work orders View.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Change location to {Location-B}.
  2. Open "Work Orders" > "All" and click "Tech View".
  3. Click "Board View".
  4. Click "Add Technician".
  5. Change location to {Location-C}.
  6. Open "Work Orders" > "All" and click "Board View".
  7. Click "Tech View".
  8. Sign out and sign in as {User-B}.
  9. Change location to {Location-B}.
  10. Open "Work Orders" > "All" and click "Board View".
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the top bar shows {Location-B}.
  • Step 2: Tech View shows only the "Unassigned" group. Below it are a person icon, "No technicians yet", the text "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned." and an "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 3: Board View shows only the "Unassigned" column, followed by the same icon, "No technicians yet", the same text and the "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 4: the Staff page in Settings opens (the page where staff are added).
  • Step 5: the top bar shows {Location-C}.
  • Step 6: Board View reads "Nothing here yet", then "Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech.", with a "Create Work Order" button and an "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 7: Tech View shows the same: "Nothing here yet", the same text, "Create Work Order" and "Add Technician".
  • Step 8: you are signed in as {User-B}.
  • Step 9: the top bar shows {Location-B}.
  • Step 10: Board View shows the "Unassigned" column and "No technicians yet" with its text, and there is no "Add Technician" button.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043 · story SV-10044 · Chris Ward's answer 16 on the WO Board design-differences sheet (19 Oct 2026)

  • S1-N1d: “When the location has no technicians but has work orders, Tech View and Board View show only Unassigned, followed by the design’s state: the user-round icon, “No technicians yet”, then “Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.”, with an Add Technician button. When the location has neither technicians nor work orders, the state reads “Nothing here yet”, then “Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech.”, with the Create Work Order button of S1-N1c and the Add Technician button. Add Technician opens Settings → Staff, the page where staff are added, and shows only to users with 'Settings → App', the permission that opens that page.”

Not yet checked against a build.

References from Design

Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html and its flows, driven 14 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026: where the design draws these states; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, first-run titles: “const frTitle = noWo && noTech ? "Nothing here yet" : noWo ? "No work orders yet" : "No technicians yet";”
  • Design — seen when driven (FLOWS-2026-10-14.md, W5): “no-technicians → "No technicians yet" + "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned." + Add Technician”

AUTOMATION: READY

changes.old_value:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the location changes.
  • Step 2: Board View opens.
  • Step 3: it reads "No technicians yet" and "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.", with an "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 4: the location changes.
  • Step 5: Board View opens.
  • Step 6: it reads "Nothing here yet" and "Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech."

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: Empty states when a location has no technicians: the design shows "No technicians yet" / "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned." with Add Technician, and "Nothing here yet" when there are neither (designer review frames); the PRD says only the no-work-orders state ("No work orders yet"). It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D16 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

What the PRD says instead:

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043

  • S1-N1c: “When no filter and no search are active and the filter view has no work orders at all, Tech View and Board View show the design’s first-run state: the clipboard-list icon in a grey circle, “No work orders yet”, then “Create a work order and assign a technician to see it here.”, with a Create Work Order button that does the same as the page’s Create Work Order button. List keeps its production empty state.”
